questions.questionHtml:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements :

Some bulbs are switches.

No switch is a vase.

I. Some bulbs being fans is a possibility.

II. No fan is a vase.

III. All switches are fans.

options.text: Only Conclusions II and III follow
options.html: Only Conclusions II and III follow

options.text: Only Conclusions I and II follow

options.text: Only Conclusions I, II and IV follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

Conclusions:

I. Some bulbs being fans is a possibility → Follow (As some bulbs are switches and all fans are switches. So, as there is no direct negative or cross relation between bulbs and fans therefore some bulbs can be fans is definitely true)

II. No fan is a vase → Follow (As no switch is a vase and all fans are switches. So, as whole fans comes in switches therefore whole fans too have negative or cross relation with vase therefore it is definitely true)

III. All switches are fans → Does not follow (As all fans are switches. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

IV. No bulb is a vase → Does not follow (As some bulbs are switches and no switch is a vase. So, as there is no direct negative or cross relation between bulbs and fans therefore it is definitely false)

∴ Here, Only conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusions I and II follow".

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the correct collocation. Motorists committing this infraction are _______ fined.
questions.questionHtml:
Fill in the blank with the correct collocation. 

Motorists committing this infraction are _______ fined.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: heavily

Key Points

  • Collocation is the combination of words formed when two or more words are often used together in a way that sounds correct.
  • Let us look at the meaning of the given words.
    • Wholly: Entirely; fully. (पूर्णत)
    • Hardly: In a severe or harsh manner. (कठिनाई से)
    • Slowly: At a slow speed; not quickly. (धीरे से)
    • Heavily: To a great degree; in large amounts. (भारी)
  • "Heavily fined" means charging someone an amount of money as a punishment for not obeying a rule or law.
  • So, as per the meaning of the given words "Heavily" should be used here.
  • The implied meaning of the sentence is: Drivers who violate this rule face hefty fines.
  • Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.
     

Complete sentence: Motorists committing this infraction are heavily fined.
